info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Marketing Promotional Event-spec
info.description: The Marketing Promotional Event Management API enables businesses to create and manage promotional events to enhance customer engagement. This API facilitates the submission of event details, including special offers and event attributes, aimed at attracting consumers. Typical use cases include marketing teams uploading new promotions and event managers fine-tuning existing event information. Integration with this API allows for streamlined event creation, enabling more effective marketing strategies and improving customer outreach.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new promotional event in the marketing system. You can specify various details related to the event, which will be stored for further use in marketing campaigns.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new promotional event in the marketing system. It should include all necessary details such as event title, description, date, and any associated promotional materials.

201.description: Successfully created a new promotional event.
